next.reason: 1985: EXIT PROGRAM in a called initial program 'is equivalent also to executing a CANCEL statement referencing that program'. 2023: EXIT PROGRAM in a called program follows GOBACK (§2023:14.9.14.4 GR3, read as GOBACK GR1-2, see X.5.4.4-2), and for an initial program 'an implicit CANCEL statement referencing that program is executed upon return to the calling runtime element' (§2023:14.9.18.4 GR2). Same effect. GR-8.5.1.11.3-2 covers only freeing variable-length storage.
